reportedSymptom: User still reached https://archestimator.com/?error=state_mismatch after prior recovery adapter.

change.summary: The edge adapter now applies Clear-Site-Data plus broad Better Auth OAuth state-cookie cleanup on callback state mismatches and on the final /login?error=state_mismatch retry page, not only on the original root/API error URL.
change.rootAndApiRetry: GET /?error=state_mismatch and /api/auth/error?error=state_mismatch still 302 to /login?next=/workshop&error=state_mismatch with no-store, cookie cleanup, and Clear-Site-Data.
change.callbackMismatch: GET /api/auth/callback/google with a state parameter but no matching Better Auth OAuth state cookie now 302s to the retry login page with no-store, cookie cleanup, and Clear-Site-Data.
change.loginRetryPage: GET /login?next=/workshop&error=state_mismatch forwards to the app but overrides cache-control to no-store and appends OAuth state-cookie cleanup plus Clear-Site-Data, so a browser that ignored a prior redirect cleanup still starts the next Google attempt cleanly.
change.normalLoginPage: GET /login?next=/workshop remains untouched and keeps the app response without cleanup headers.

verification.command: bunx wrangler deployments list --name archestimator-auth-callback-normalizer -c wrangler.auth-callback-normalizer.jsonc --json

verification.details: HTTP 302 to https://archestimator.com/login?next=%2Fworkshop&error=state_mismatch with private no-store, Expires: 0, Pragma: no-cache, OAuth state-cookie cleanup, and Clear-Site-Data: "cookies".
HTTP 200 login retry page now carries private no-store, Expires: 0, Pragma: no-cache, OAuth state-cookie cleanup, and Clear-Site-Data: "cookies".
Normal login page remains HTTP 200 without the recovery cleanup headers.
Missing-cookie callback returns HTTP 302 to retry login with no-store, OAuth state-cookie cleanup, and Clear-Site-Data: "cookies".
Stale-cookie callback returns HTTP 302 to retry login with no-store, OAuth state-cookie cleanup, and Clear-Site-Data: "cookies".

verification.command: Playwright fresh context: /?error=state_mismatch -> retry login -> Continue with Google -> fake-code callback
verification.details: After the retry page, Better Auth cookies were empty; Google received redirect_uri=https://archestimator.com/api/auth/callback/google; a new 32-character state cookie matched the Google state; fake-code callback ended at https://archestimator.com/?error=invalid_code, proving state validation passed.
